items.name: Fourth Hokage Minato Inspired Oversized T-Shirt - Premium Flame Print Anime Streetwear
items.title: Fourth Hokage Minato Inspired Oversized T-Shirt - Premium Flame Print Anime Streetwear
items.desc:
Product Overview
Unleash the spirit of the Hidden Leaf's fastest shinobi. This premium drop-shoulder oversized tee brings the iconic aesthetic of the Fourth Hokage’s legendary cloak straight into modern streetwear. Featuring a bold dual-tone color block and crisp graphic elements, it’s a must-have statement piece for every anime enthusiast.
Product Features
• Authentic Design: Replicates the iconic burgundy fire border from the signature Hokage cloak wrapping around a clean cream-colored body.
• Premium Graphics: Features a high-density print of the fire kanji (火) on the front chest and the vertical Fourth Hokage character inscription (四代目火影) boldly running down the back.
• Streetwear Fit: Trendy oversized silhouette with dropped shoulders and loose half-sleeves for ultimate casual comfort.
• Durable Comfort: Crafted from heavy-density, breathable cotton blend fabric designed to hold its boxy shape wash after wash.
Style & Pairing Tips
Rock this oversized graphic tee with black cargo pants, utility joggers, or distressed denim. Finish the look with high-top sneakers for an effortless, streetwear-ready vibe.
Material & Care
• Fabric: Premium Heavyweight Cotton Blend
• Fit: Oversized / Loose Fit
• Neckline: Classic Crew Neck
• Care Instructions: Machine wash cold inside-out with like colors. Tumble dry low. Do not iron directly over printed graphics.
